title: Grateful Dead Live at Family Dog at the Great Highway on 1969-08-03
venue: Family Dog at the Great Highway
lineage: Dat (Sony R500) -> SEK'D Prodif Plus -> Samplitude Professional v7.02 -> FLAC

ai_review.summary: Pure soundboard capture with good clarity frames a wild, jazz‑infused Dark Star, The Other One and Caution backed by guest violin and sax.
ai_review.review: The show is a standout moment in the Dead’s late‑60s era – a free‑jazz‑colored Dark Star, an epic Other One and a scorching Caution are powered by David LaFlamme’s violin and Charles Lloyd’s sax.  Recording quality is solid for a straight soundboard source (little hiss, clear mix) though the early part of the set suffers from volume swings and occasional speed wobble.  Overall the performance is high‑energy, adventurous and widely praised by listeners.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers give 5‑star ratings and highlight exceptional musical moments; recording is described as a clean soundboard with minor early flaws, yielding an overall strong combined score.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Generally clear and low‑hiss soundboard tape. Early tracks fluctuate in volume and speed, and Caution’s level varies wildly, but the mix becomes clean after the first few songs.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The concert starts a bit tentative, but once the guest violin and sax join the band it erupts into free‑jazz improvisation; Dark Star lifts the show, leading to a soaring Other One and a chaotic yet thrilling Caution.

band_member_comments.Jerry: His guitar tone is praised early on; later he backs off in Dark Star to let the sax and violin shine while still providing rhythmic support.
band_member_comments.Phil: Noted for his deep voice on the closing "And We Bid You Goodnight" and solid bass foundation throughout.
band_member_comments.Keys: Tom Constanten (TC) adds circus‑like organ accents, listens closely to guests and delivers some of his best playing on this night.
band_member_comments.Drums: Bill Kreutzmann supplies dynamic fills and a brief drum break that propels the Other One forward.
